slides.name: Machine Chest Press
slides.text: handles at mid-chest. press straight out, control it back.

slides.name: Pulldown
slides.text: wide or neutral grip. elbows down to your sides.

slides.name: Chest-Supported Row
slides.text: chest on the pad so you can't swing. pull your elbows back.

slides.name: Lateral Raise
slides.text: lead with your elbows. stop at shoulder height.

slides.name: Preacher Curl
slides.text: the pad stops you swinging. control it all the way down.

slides.name: Poliquin Pushdown
slides.text: elbows pinned to your sides. squeeze at the bottom.

slides.label: real tip
slides.text: same 6 exercises every upper A. last week's numbers are the target.
